question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing goalkeeper, and Eve is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Finally, Dave and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right back
(C) cheerleader
(D) goalkeeper
(E) center midfielder
solution:
Positions are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: (left midfielder, right back, cheerleader, goalkeeper, center midfielder)
1. Dave and Alice swap: (goalkeeper, right back, cheerleader, left midfielder, center midfielder)
2. Claire and Bob swap: (goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, left midfielder, center midfielder)
3. Alice and Eve swap: (center midfielder, cheerleader, right back, left midfielder, goalkeeper)
4. Alice and Dave swap: (left midfielder, cheerleader, right back, center midfielder, goalkeeper)
5. Dave and Alice swap: (center midfielder, cheerleader, right back, left midfielder, goalkeeper)
Dave plays left midfielder, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
